# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-10-31 from the 2026-10-31 Hub dump.

- 3,197,359 models tracked, 913,130 declare a base model, 946,320 parent links, 90,164 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
